overview_description.description: Names & Faces creates tools to help organizations build fast, beautiful directories of their teams to help people orient themselves, feel more welcome and to encourage more real-life interactions. What we’ve built is not a new social network — the world knows we don’t need another one of those — and it’s not a new communication tool. It’s the simplest, fastest and most useful people directory ever developed.

product.name: Names & Faces Directory and Org Chart
product.description: A cloud-based tool that creates and maintains an up-to-date employee directory and organizational chart by syncing with HRIS systems or spreadsheets.

product.name: Data Integration Services
product.description: Services that connect multiple data sources, including HRIS systems and spreadsheets, to consolidate employee information into a single directory and org chart.

product.name: Customizable Directory Features
product.description: Features that allow users to customize employee directories with tailored categories, filters, branding, and reporting lines.
